label: Four Futures foundation
description: A low-friction research path: enter one research brief, compare four What-if futures, choose exactly one branch, select tools, then generate one scenario in a focused scope.

stages.label: Input cards
stages.description: Capture the topic, point of view, research concern, assumptions, stakeholders, and tension as one editable research brief. Keywords remain a derived detail of this same input stage.

stages.label: Four What-if futures
stages.description: Run the existing Guided Scenario operation from direct research inputs only, compare exactly four branches, and choose one before proceeding.

stages.label: Choose tools
stages.description: Attach one registry-backed tool node to the selected branch Scope. Tools can be changed and re-run without creating a second active scenario line.

stages.label: Generate scenario
stages.description: Run the selected tools into one current scenario output. Earlier outputs remain available as superseded history, never as parallel active conclusions.

zh.label: 四种未来基础流程
zh.description: 低门槛研究路径：以信息卡片输入研究议题，比较四个 What-if，且仅选择一个方向；然后选择工具并生成一条当前情境。
